visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy in a black t-shirt and glasses plays a brown piano in a bright, white-tiled room. A woman in a beige blazer stands behind him, looking at her phone with an annoyed expression. Purple text overlays '陶醉' appear near the boy. (2) The woman gestures angrily at the music score, shouting. Red flame graphics surround her. The boy looks tense. (3) A sudden transition occurs: the woman smiles broadly, placing her hand on the boy's shoulder. Sparkle effects and the 'uniopen' logo appear. (4) The boy is lying on a brown couch reading a book. The woman enters, shouting about his smelly feet; green odor lines are edited over his foot. (5) The woman checks her phone and immediately becomes joyful again, repeating the happy gesture. (6) The boy is playing on the floor. The woman scolds him for torn pants, pointing to a hole. (7) The boy questions her behavior. The woman then speaks directly to the camera, explaining the 'uniopen' app with screen recordings of the interface and various brand logos. (8) Final promotional slides show referral codes and reward points with the woman gesturing enthusiastically.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with dark hair tied back wearing a beige blazer and a young boy with glasses wearing a black 'Future Steinway Artist' t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern home interior with white walls, a piano, a brown textured couch, and tiled floors. The second half features an app's digital interface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Audio begins with a rhythmic piano melody and a light synth beat. (2) A sharp transition occurs with a loud, aggressive female voice scolding in Mandarin, accompanied by a cartoonish fire-crackling sound effect. (3) A magical 'Ding' sound effect marks a sudden shift to an extremely high-pitched, soft, and cheerful female voice saying 'uniopen'. (4) Loud shouting returns as the woman complains about foot odor, with frantic speech delivery. (5) Another 'Whoosh' transition leads back to the cheerful catchphrase with sparkly SFX. (6) A young male voice speaks in a confused and slightly annoyed tone, asking about the catchphrase. (7) The woman transitions to a professional promotional narrative with a clear, enunciated tone over an upbeat pop background track. (8) Frequent UI sound effects and celebratory 'Ding' sounds occur as she lists app benefits and referral rewards.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video uses a humorous skit format to illustrate how the frustrations of motherhood (messy kids, bad smells, household chores) can be instantly alleviated by the rewards and convenience of the 'uniopen' app. It aims to encourage downloads through a referral point program.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of app interface, promotion of referral code v68pyl, and listing of reward points.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses the 'mood flip' trope to create a comedic contrast between real-life parenting stress and the joy of digital rewards.
